description: I bought a SAMSUNG washing machine for 18900 UAH. NOVA POSHTA delivered it to my local branch on 2025-10-15 in a sealed factory box, so I did not open it at the branch. At home I found small holes from shrapnel in the box and in the drum housing. The washing machine is damaged and unsafe to use. The waybill shows the parcel was shipped from a warehouse in Brovary, so I cannot tell whether it was hit at the SAMSUNG warehouse, at a NOVA POSHTA terminal or during delivery.

NOVA POSHTA express waybill 20450555123456

Parcel condition at delivery: sealed, no visible damage
